calculation.description: For each tradable asset, compute 40-day average positive daily return relative to average absolute negative daily return, subtract one, then take the contrarian negative and scale by annualized 40-day volatility plus 0.10. Inputs use closes through the decision date only; higher values indicate more attractive reversal after accounting for realized risk.

validation.regime_notes: 60-day cross-sectional Spearman IC was positive in 2024-2026 (+0.2262), 2027-2029 (+0.2338), 2030 (+0.2157), and 2031-2032 (+0.0844), but mildly negative in 2033 YTD (-0.0119). Interpret conservatively given the 15-asset universe and recent drift.

provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation; minimum 8 valid instruments
